meta.title: Claude Code preset
meta.description: Adds an agent preset whose system prompt is Claude Code's own prompt text: identity, harness rules, doing tasks, code style, action safety, delivering and finishing work, communication, reporting outcomes, corrections, git, untrusted input, tool usage, and style. DeepSeek Harness tool plugins keep contributing their own tool mechanics, so tool calling, sandboxing, compaction, delegation, and the runtime context are unchanged. Pick it from the agent preset roster when starting a session.
